segments.text: Als Zarathustra dreissig Jahr alt war, verliess er seine Heimat und den See seiner Heimat und gieng in das Gebirge. Hier genoss er seines Geistes und seiner Einsamkeit und wurde dessen zehn Jahre nicht müde. Endlich aber verwandelte sich sein Herz, — und eines Morgens stand er mit der Morgenröthe auf, trat vor die Sonne hin und sprach zu ihr also:
„Du grosses Gestirn! Was wäre dein Glück, wenn du nicht Die hättest, welchen du leuchtest!
Zehn Jahre kamst du hier herauf zu meiner Höhle: du würdest deines Lichtes und dieses Weges satt geworden sein, ohne mich, meinen Adler und meine Schlange.
Aber wir warteten deiner an jedem Morgen, nahmen dir deinen Überfluss ab und segneten dich dafür.
Siehe! Ich bin meiner Weisheit überdrüssig, wie die Biene, die des Honigs zu viel gesammelt hat,

ich bedarf der Hände, die sich ausstrecken. Ich möchte verschenken und austheilen, bis die Weisen unter den Menschen wieder einmal ihrer Thorheit und die Armen wieder einmal ihres Reichthums froh geworden sind.
Dazu muss ich in die Tiefe steigen: wie du des Abends thust, wenn du hinter das Meer gehst und noch der Unterwelt Licht bringst, du überreiches Gestirn!
Ich muss, gleich dir, *untergehen*, wie die Menschen es nennen, zu denen ich hinab will.
So segne mich denn, du ruhiges Auge, das ohne Neid auch ein allzugrosses Glück sehen kann!
Segne den Becher, welcher überfliessen will, dass das Wasser golden aus ihm fliesse und überallhin den Abglanz deiner Wonne trage!
Siehe! Dieser Becher will wieder leer werden, und Zarathustra will wieder Mensch werden.“
— Also begann Zarathustra's Untergang.

segments.text:
Когда Заратустре исполнилось тридцать лет,
он оставил свою родину и озеро своей родины — 
и ушёл в горы.
Здесь он вкушал свой дух и своё одиночество 
и в течении десяти лет не уставал от этого.
И всё же наконец преобразилось его сердце —;
и однажды утром он встал с самой утренней зарёй,
вышел перед солнцем и так говорил к нему:

“Ты, великое светило!
Что бы стало твоим счастьем,
если бы у тебя не было тех, кому ты светишь!

Десять лет ты поднималось ко мне, к моей пещере:
ты пресытилось бы своим светом и этим путём,
если бы не я,
мой орёл и моя змея.

Но мы каждое утро выжидали тебя,
принимали от тебя твой избыток
и благословляли тебя за это.”

я нуждаюсь в руках, которые простираются;
я хотел бы дарить и раздавать,
пока мудрые среди людей
снова не будут радоваться своей глупости,
а бедные — своему богатству.

Для этого я должен спуститься в глубину,
как ты делаешь это вечером,
когда ты уходишь за море
и ещё подземному миру приносишь свет,
ты, сверхизобильная звезда!

Я должен, подобно тебе, *закатиться*,
как называют это люди,
к которым я хочу спуститься.

Так благослови же меня, ты спокойное око,
которое без зависти смотрит даже на слишком большое счастье!

Благослови чашу,
которая хочет перелиться,
чтобы золото из неё текло
и повсюду несло отблеск твоего ликования!

Смотри!
Эта чаша хочет вновь стать пустой,
и Заратустра хочет вновь стать человеком.”
– Так начался закат Заратустры.

segments.text: When Zarathustra was thirty years old, he left his homeland and the lake of his homeland and went into the mountains. Here he delighted in his spirit and his solitude, and for ten years did not grow weary of them. But at last his heart transformed itself, — and one morning he rose with the dawn, stepped before the sun, and spoke thus to it:
“You great star! What would your happiness be, if you did not have those to whom you shine!
For ten years you came up here to my cave: you would have grown sated with your light and this path, without me, my eagle, and my serpent.
But we awaited you every morning, relieved you of your overflow, and blessed you for it.
Behold! I am weary of my wisdom, like the bee that has gathered too much honey;
I need outstretched hands. I would bestow and distribute, until the wise among men have once again become glad of their folly, and the poor once again of their wealth.
For that I must descend into the deep: as you do in the evening when you go behind the sea and still bring light to the underworld, you over-rich star!
I must, like you, *go under*, as men call it, to go down to them.
So bless me then, you tranquil eye, that can behold even an all-too-great happiness without envy!
Bless the cup that wants to overflow, so that the water may flow golden from it and carry everywhere the reflection of your bliss!
Behold! This cup wants to become empty again, and Zarathustra wants to become man again.”
— Thus began Zarathustra’s going-under.

translation_tensions.note: 'Einsamkeit' is kept as chosen solitude rather than accidental loneliness, and 'verwandelte sich sein Herz' remains an inner transformation rather than a mere change of mood.
'Gestirn' is kept broad enough to preserve star and luminary valence; the witness layers should not reduce the image to a merely astronomical label.
'Überfluss' is treated as overflow available for reciprocal reception; the movement remains mutual blessing rather than one-sided illumination.
'Thorheit' remains philosophically charged as folly with an edge toward madness; the route should not flatten it into mere stupidity or comic error.
'Unterwelt' remains the underworld of downward address and light-bearing descent rather than an abstract elsewhere or neutral distance.
'untergehen' is preserved as down-going or going-under; Russian 'закатиться' keeps the solar and recurrent motion without reducing the act to defeat alone.

'Abglanz' remains afterglow, reflection, or reflected radiance; witness layers should keep the difference between source light and carried shine. 'Wonne' and 'ликование' keep the image affectively high without collapsing into mere pleasure.

'wieder Mensch werden' is held as a return into the human after ripening, not as simple regression to a prior self; here return stays an action, while eternal return remains only a hidden rhythm of the route.

properties.distilled_thesis: The bee is the image-bearing gatherer that supports the route's scene of accumulated sweetness without itself becoming canonical analogy doctrine.

properties.distilled_thesis: Bestowal names one mode of the gift as Zarathustra's abundance begins to move outward.

properties.distilled_thesis: Blessing is the act-surface Zarathustra asks from the tranquil eye before the overflowing cup scene unfolds.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.9 (1,1,1,9)

properties.distilled_thesis: Bliss names the high solar joy whose reflection the cup carries abroad.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.10 (1,1,1,10)

properties.distilled_thesis: The cave marks the threshold place of solitude and reception, the height to which the sun has long come.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.3 (1,1,1,3)

properties.distilled_thesis: The cup is the vessel-symbol that gathers, overflows, empties, and parallels Zarathustra's own motion.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.10 (1,1,1,10)

properties.distilled_thesis: Dawn is the time-sign that frames Zarathustra's first direct address to the sun.

properties.distilled_thesis: Depth is the destination-symbol of descent, the lower direction that gift must take.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.7 (1,1,1,7)

properties.distilled_thesis: Distribution names the second mode of the gift, turning Zarathustra's abundance outward toward humans.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.6 (1,1,1,6)

properties.distilled_thesis: The eagle is one of Zarathustra's companion symbols within the route's triadic collective.

properties.distilled_thesis: Emptiness is the state-target toward which the cup aims when it wants to empty again.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.11 (1,1,1,11)

properties.distilled_thesis: Envy is the excluded affect whose absence defines the tranquility of the eye.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.9 (1,1,1,9)

properties.distilled_thesis: Evening is the time-sign of the sun's movement beyond the sea toward the underworld.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.7 (1,1,1,7)

properties.distilled_thesis: Folly is the tension-term the wise among humans are said to greet gladly in the route's revaluation scene.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.6 (1,1,1,6)

properties.distilled_thesis: Go-under is the humanly named hinge-term that gathers descent, sunset, and approach toward human recipients.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.12 (1,1,1,7)

properties.distilled_thesis: Gold is the quality that marks the water as radiant in the cup's overflowing movement.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.10 (1,1,1,10)

properties.distilled_thesis: Happiness here is not private contentment but a relational joy whose meaning depends on those illuminated by it.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.2 (1,1,1,2)

properties.distilled_thesis: The heart marks the inner center that transforms before the route turns outward into speech.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.1 (1,1,1,1)

properties.distilled_thesis: The homeland is the settled place Zarathustra leaves at the route's opening, making departure concrete rather than merely inward.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.1 (1,1,1,1)

properties.distilled_thesis: Honey is the gathered sweetness of the bee-image, supporting the route's scene of accumulated abundance at overfull wisdom.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.5 (1,1,1,5)

properties.distilled_thesis: The human appears here as the condition Zarathustra wants to become again, so return is anchored in renewed human nearness rather than abstraction.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.11 (1,1,1,11)

properties.distilled_thesis: Humans are the receiving horizon of the route, the human field toward which gift, going-under, and return are directed.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.6 (1,1,1,6)

properties.distilled_thesis: The lake of the homeland is the paired place-symbol left behind at the start, sharpening the opening break of the route.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.1 (1,1,1,1)

properties.distilled_thesis: Light is the radiance carried across the route, from the sun's giving to the later reflection that is borne onward.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.3 (1,1,1,3)

properties.distilled_thesis: Morning is the recurring time of the triad's waiting for the sun.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.4 (1,1,1,4)

properties.distilled_thesis: The mountains are the withdrawn place of ascent where Zarathustra's solitude and long ripening are held.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.1 (1,1,1,1)

properties.distilled_thesis: Outstretched hands are the recipient-interface the route names as necessary for giving to become actual bestowal.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.5 (1,1,1,5)

properties.distilled_thesis: Overflow names the abundance that can be received, blessed, and later poured outward again.
properties.source_anchor: Friedrich Nietzsche, Also sprach Zarathustra, Zarathustra's Vorrede 1, route-local support surface grounded through tos.source.thus-spoke-zarathustra.prologue and first anchored at seg.1.1.1.10 (1,1,1,4)

properties.distilled_thesis: Path names the route-image whose possible saturation the triadic companionship prevents in the sun scene.

properties.distilled_thesis: The poor among humans are the subgroup whose joy is revalued toward wealth within the same human field.

properties.distilled_thesis: Solitude names the held condition delighted in during the mountain interval, the seclusion from which later speech and descent emerge.
